text: Solid Waste Management Services is responsible for collecting, transporting, processing, composting and disposing of municipal and some private sector solid waste. The Auditor General’s 2025 Work Plan included an audit of Solid Waste Management Services’ contract management processes. From July 2022 to July 2025, Solid Waste Management Services’ contract portfolio included over 300 contracts valued at $1.8 billion, with the earliest contract starting in 2011 and some ending in 2030. This audit focused on contracts managed by two Solid Waste Management Services sections: Infrastructure and Resource Management and Collection and Litter Operations.
